rows.name: [VV-04 FIXTURE] Air-Gapped Model Provenance Ledger
rows.problem_statement: No tamper-evident provenance trail for models trained inside an IL6 enclave.
rows.proposed_capability: Append-only, hash-chained ledger recording dataset, weights, and eval lineage per model release.

rows.name: [VV-04 FIXTURE] Cross-Canvas Threat Narrative Synth
rows.problem_statement: Analysts manually stitch signals across canvases into a threat story.
rows.proposed_capability: Auto-compose a cited threat narrative from correlated signals.

rows.name: [VV-04 FIXTURE] Yet Another Dashboard Dark-Mode Toggle
rows.problem_statement: Some users want a light theme.
rows.proposed_capability: Add a theme toggle to the dashboard chrome.

rows.name: [VV-04 FIXTURE] Continuous ATO Drift Sentinel
rows.problem_statement: Control drift between assessments goes unnoticed until the next audit.
rows.proposed_capability: Continuously diff live config against the approved control baseline.
